items.statement: 最终：动力学操作与循环累积 cis 的解释
items.expected: The final explanation reconciles trans-favored endpoint thermodynamics, near-equal single-pass stereochemical outcome and accumulating cis through separation/recycling. Interpret the reported 70% after three rounds as cumulative isolated yield, not a changed equilibrium or exact yield predicted by the ideal model. Do not select one of the conflicting published solvent ratios as uniquely certain.
